eyebrow: Momcozy · NYC Oct 2026 home shoot, Jordana & Gabe, Bedminster NJ · 21 Oct 2026 · BM04 + BN02 UGC
title: Dad's day:
headline: Mom is out, so Gabe runs the day: cooking with the BM04 on the counter, clearing Jamie's nose with the BN02, nap, a fix-it job, and a happy hand-off when Jordana walks in.
story: Peter's October brief, UGC video 2: Helping Dad Enjoy a More Confident Parenting Experience with BM04 and BN02. Gabe opens to camera with his line, then we see a calm, capable dad. The products sit inside the day: the monitor next to him while he cooks, the aspirator at the table with Jamie on his lap.
Keep it light and real. Quick cuts, natural sound low, one track. No feature talk. The Momcozy note on this brief asks for real, casual use, not a product walk-through.
Loops: L1 “How does dad do on his own?” opens at 0:00 and closes when Jordana walks in. Stakes: one dad, one toddler, a full day.
do: Open on Gabe already talking, hook text already on screen at 0:00.
Every monitor shot shows the baby on its screen.
Use only calm moments of Jamie with the aspirator.
Fast cuts, 1 to 2 s per B-roll shot.
End on the family hug, then the end card.
dont: No logo, name or fade at 0:00.
No crying or resisting at the aspirator. Do not use IMG_9470, IMG_9472 or IMG_9473 (Jamie is upset).
No director audio. Atdhe is talking on most clips.
Do not show the phone screen up close: it shows the home screen, not the app.

bp_intro: All clips are vertical iPhone HEVC, 3840×2160 with rotation (plays 2160×3840), about 24 fps. Times are mm:ss.s in each clip, from a machine transcript and keyframes pulled this run, good to about 1 s. Frames below are real keyframes from the clips.

rows.frame_alt: Gabe, black tee, selfie to camera in the bright living room, smiling.
rows.visual: Gabe to camera, IMG_9424.MOV, already talking on frame 1. Start at 00:00.4. This is the clean full take. Hand-held selfie, keep it as shot.
rows.motion: Hook text on frame 1: MOM'S OUT. DAD'S IN CHARGE. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on. Top third, Inter Bold, white with a soft shadow. No logo, no name, no fade.

voice.quote: My wife is out today. I'm in charge of taking care of the baby. Come along with me and see how it goes.

rows.music: Light, playful track starts on frame 1, low under his voice.

rows.frame_alt: BM04 parent unit on the granite counter in the foreground, Gabe cooking behind it.
rows.visual: 3 quick cuts. (1) IMG_9425.MOV 00:11.8 to 00:16.8: BM04 on the counter, Gabe cooking behind it. (2) IMG_9426.MOV 00:07.7: he reaches for the eggs. (3) IMG_9426.MOV 01:16.7 on: at the stove. Baby must read on the monitor screen in cut 1.
rows.motion: Hook text off on the cut. Captions only.
rows.voice: No dialogue. The audio on these clips is Atdhe directing: mute it.
rows.sfx: Pan sizzle, soft, under the music.

rows.frame_alt: Close-up of the BM04 screen: the baby asleep in the crib, pink blanket. Gabe's hand at the edge.
rows.visual: Close-up of the BM04 screen with the baby asleep. IMG_9425.MOV 01:14.9 to 01:22.0, or IMG_9426.MOV 00:23.0. Hold 2 s so the baby reads. Do not use IMG_9426.MOV around 00:54: the screen is black there.
Script shot 3 (Dad feeds the baby with a bottle). Not found in the footage. Skip it. Go straight to the aspirator.

rows.frame_alt: Gabe at the wood table with Jamie on his lap, bringing the BN02 tip, lit pink, up to her nose.
rows.visual: 2 to 3 angles, about 1.5 s each, all Gabe with Jamie at the table. (1) IMG_9468.MOV 00:21.8 to 00:26.0: he shows her the colored light. (2) IMG_9469.MOV 00:00.0 to 00:01.7: tip at her nose. (3) IMG_9469.MOV 00:28.3 to 00:30.0: tip up to her nose again. Use only the moments where she is calm. Optional 1 s cutaway: IMG_9480.MOV 00:05.8 to 00:13.3, Gabe rinsing the tip at the sink.
rows.voice: No dialogue. Natural sound very low. Jamie says "No" on these clips: keep it out.
rows.sfx: Soft hum of the aspirator, very low, only if clean.

rows.frame_alt: Dim nursery, Gabe bending over the crib, laying Jamie down.
rows.visual: IMG_9479.MOV 00:08.6 to 00:15.0: Gabe carries Jamie to the crib in the dim nursery and lays her down. Start after Jordana walks out of frame (she is in the shot before 00:08.6).

rows.frame_alt: Gabe on the landing with a yellow drill, working on the door frame.
rows.visual: (1) IMG_9428.MOV 00:12.5 to 00:17.5: drilling at the door frame. (2) IMG_9428.MOV 00:20.0 to 00:27.5: he checks his phone, then looks up and breathes out. His phone screen shows the home screen, not the app. Keep the phone screen small or out of focus. Then cut to the BM04 screen insert with the baby (IMG_9426.MOV 00:30.5) as what he checks.

rows.frame_alt: Jordana in a tan cardigan walks into the living room, smiling.
rows.visual: IMG_9471.MOV 00:09.2 to 00:15.8: Gabe with Jamie on his lap, Jordana walks in, they greet, she reaches for Jamie.

voice.quote: Hey, how was your day? Good. Good. How was the get together? It was good. It was good. I'll take her.

rows.frame_alt: Jordana lifts Jamie up and kisses her, Gabe leans in.
rows.visual: IMG_9471.MOV 00:15.8 to 00:18.0: Jordana lifts Jamie, Gabe leans in for a kiss. Out before the camera drops to the table at 00:18.3.
End card: MOMCOZY wordmark in Cozy Chestnut #6A2B3A on Warm Cream #FEF9F6. BM04 + BN02 product names under it in Inter.

checklist: Frame 1 is Gabe already talking, with the hook text. No logo or fade.
The hook text is on screen at 0:00 and does not animate on.
Every monitor shot shows the baby on its screen.
No shot of Jamie crying or pushing the aspirator away.
No director voice anywhere in the mix.
Captions are easy to read on every line.
MOMCOZY wordmark only on the end card.

decisions.b: Script shot 3 (Dad feeds the baby with a bottle) is not in the footage. The plan skips it.
Gabe's phone shows the home screen, not the BM04 app. The plan cuts to the BM04 parent unit screen instead. If Momcozy needs the app view, a phone screen recording of the app with the baby is needed.
The clear on-nose moments are short (IMG_9469 00:00 to 00:02 and 00:28 to 00:30). Check them before V1. If they do not read as real use, flag it.
The script line "Was the baby good today?" was not said in the usable take. IMG_9471 has "How was the get together? It was good." The plan uses what was said.

client_note: Why this matters: Peter asked for real, correct product use with the baby on camera, and a dad who looks confident. Soft sell, natural moments.
